tasks.label: Flash (OpenOCD, SWD)
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -f target/rp2040.cfg -c "program ${workspaceFolder}/build/src/blink.elf verify reset exit"
tasks.detail: Requires a Debug Probe (official or DIY) wired per docs/07-debugging-swd.md. Swap to interface/linuxgpiod.cfg if using direct Pi GPIO wiring instead.
